text: Thank you. whoever suggested whisper flow. I'm very disappointed to see after the update Free version is only 2,000 words now, it used to be 8,000 for the week. it was 8,000 while they were using me to train their system. 5000 would have been fair. I realized that it's better than nothing, but it becomes the point where you have to weigh whether it's worth keeping the app in your phone. I'm going to try some of the other apps I see suggested here.
